sentences.text: Razzak S/o Mustak Khan, Aged About 19 Years,
R/o  Hindsor, P.s. Rajiyasar, District Sri Ganganagar.
(Presently Lodged At District Jail, Sri Ganganagar)

2. Talab Hussain @ Talib S/o Laskar Khan @ Gohil Khan,
 Aged About 20 Years, R/o Hindsor, P.s. Rajiyasar, District  Sri Ganganagar.

(Presently Lodged At District Jail, Sri Ganganagar)
 ----Petitioners  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through P.P.
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Pankaj Kumar Gupta.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Laxman Solanki, P.P.
 Mr. Aditya Singh Rathore.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 21/07/2023

This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioners who have been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.101/2023, registered at Police Station Rajiyasar, District Sriganganagar, for the offences punishable under Sections 376(D),
376(2)(N) IPC and Section 3/4, 5(G)/6 of the POCSO Act and Section 67(A) of the I.T. Act.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that parties have entered into a compromise and have decided to settle their disputes amicably in the spirit of Lok Adalat.

Learned counsel submitted that (2 of 3) [CRLMB-8903/2023] the petitioners who are aged about 19 years and 20 years respectively,
have been falsely implicated in the present case.
Learned counsel further submitted that the petitioner No.1 was having consensual relationship with the prosecutrix who is aged about 18 years.
Learned counsel further submitted that on their relationship turning strained, the prosecutrix falsely roped the present petitioners in a false case.
Challan of the case has already been filed.

The petitioners are in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore,
the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioners.

Learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant vehemently opposed the bail application.

However, learned counsel for the complainant submitted that in view of the fact that the parties have entered into compromise and have decided to settle their disputes amicably in the spirit of Lok Adalat, he has no objection if the petitioners are released on bail.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/ demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the bail application filed by the petitioners deserves to be accepted.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioners (1) Razzak S/o Mustak Khan & (2) Talab Hussain @ Talib S/o Laskar Khan @
Gohil Khan arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.101/2023, registered at Police Station Rajiyasar,
District Sriganganagar, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided each of them furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for their (3 of 3) [CRLMB-8903/2023] appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 272-Prashant/-
